$comment: Tool schema template for the agentic component layer.
This is the #1 failure point: keep inputs strict and outputs explicit.
Pipeline: 1) define the tool here, 2) generate the agent-side function schema
from this JSON, 3) back the tool with an endpoint that validates against the
SAME schema, 4) run the eval suite before and after any change.
- name is verb_noun and STABLE (renaming breaks agent training + evals).
- additionalProperties must be false - never allow loose extra fields.
- every property gets a description telling the model HOW to choose the value.
- never ask the agent for a tenant_id - derive it from auth context.
- declare a distinct error shape with a machine-readable code.
name: create_repo_audit_run
description: Create a new audit run for a repository. Call when the user asks to audit, check health, or score a repo. Returns the created run with its id and status. Errors with a structured rejection if the repo URL is malformed or the repo is not reachable.

repo_url.description: Full https URL of the git repository to audit, e.g. https://github.com/acme/widgets.git. Must be a reachable https URL.

scope.description: Which audit areas to run. 'full' runs all areas; 'git' only git history; 'code' only source analysis; 'docs' only governance docs. Choose the narrowest scope that satisfies the request.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for this run (e.g. a sprint tag). Omit unless the user supplied one.
